description.zh: 数据目的ID。您可调用接口[ListDestination](~~433025~~)，查询数据目的列表，获取**DestinationId**。
description.en: The data destination ID. You can call the [ListDestination](~~433025~~) API to query the list of data destinations and obtain the **DestinationId**.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
